summary: Strive, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an underwritten offering of 7,000,000 shares of 15.00% Series A Perpetual SATS Preferred Stock at $90.00 per share ($100 stated amount/liquidation preference), raising $630.0M gross and $609.0M before expenses after $21.0M underwriting discounts. Dividends accrue at 15.00% annually on the $100 stated amount; the company intends to prefund an 18-month dividend reserve of $22.50 per share from cash and securities. Redemption is permitted only if outstanding shares fall below 25% of original issuance or on a tax event; fundamental-change repurchase rights apply. Nasdaq listing under 'SATS' is sought, with a future at-the-market program contemplated. Watch for listing approval timing, dividend reserve adequacy, and preferred overhang/valuation versus the common.
